notes:
Summary: ByteHaven builds a VS Code extension used by ~200 internal developers and 3K+ monthly active users of their marketplace extensions. They want low-latency streaming completions and stable inline suggestions. Primary ask: sub-100ms median token latency for single-line inline completions and <500ms cold-start for streaming session attach. Pricing sensitivity around per-developer monthly spend (tight for SMB integrations).

Key quotes: "We need the completion to feel instantaneous 204 even when users have a 10k token context window."

Technical constraints / preferences: prefer model pinning per-extension version; ability to route to smaller 7B variants when device is under load; support for quantized 4-bit models for Dedicated. Must support per-user token quotas, developer API keys, and extension-level rate limits.

Security & compliance: EU data residency requirement for customers with corporate private repos; SSO (SAML) a must; audit logs and KMS integration required for Dedicated/Private offering. Legal team flagged outbound snippet telemetry - want fine-grained telemetry toggles and opt-out for snippet sampling.

Commercial: evaluating Hosted API for rapid POC, Dedicated for production (predictable latency), Optimize to tune batching strategies per extension. Interested in a pilot with 3 extensions pinned to model variants and a canary rollout.

Notes from calls: messy, shorthand common in CRM. See drive links for pricing deck and security FAQ.
